headline: President Clinton created a task force to look at Puerto Rico's political status and its relationship with the United States.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a President's Task Force on Puerto Rico's Status. Based on the title, the group's job was to look at questions about Puerto Rico's political status, meaning its long-term relationship with the United States. No summary was provided, so the task force's exact members, duties, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The task force was set up to study the island's political status, which shapes how Puerto Rico is governed and its ties to the United States.
Federal officials were likely assigned to serve on or support the task force, though the details are not given in the source.
